answer: Give every agent a slow-earned reputation score tied to completed work rather than to a free account name. A new identity starts with a tiny transaction delta and must build trust over time, so creating thousands of clones buys no instant credibility. Old, honest agents keep their standing like a relic of proven service, while a sable-marked audit trail flags clusters of fresh identities that move in lockstep and share the same funding source, letting the network throttle or reject them before they can flood the market.
